evals.name: create-binary-feature
evals.prompt: Create a new devcontainer feature for jq (JSON processor). It should download from GitHub releases.
evals.expected_output: Complete feature structure in src/jq/ with devcontainer-feature.json, install.sh, test.sh using binary download pattern.
assertions: Created src/jq/install.sh using binary download pattern

evals.name: bump-version-patch
evals.prompt: I fixed a bug in my feature's install.sh - the download URL was wrong. Please bump the version.
evals.expected_output: Detects install.sh changed with same mechanism, suggests patch bump, updates version.

evals.name: add-option-minor
evals.prompt: Add an 'installPath' option to my feature so users can choose where to install the binary.
evals.expected_output: Adds option to devcontainer-feature.json, updates install.sh to use the option, bumps minor version.
assertions: Adds installPath option with proper structure
Updates install.sh to use INSTALLPATH env var
